summary: Python’s documentation teams receive a year of free access to XTM Transifex’s Growth plan, while Python 3.16.0 alpha 2 opens a new developer preview. Google rolls out several GenAI enhancements—Ask Maps holiday features, Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Search, Gemini Decisions API, and Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video generation—expanding AI capabilities across products. UiPath highlights rule‑engine‑driven AI agents and new orchestration tools, and Power Automate introduces modern attachments for flexible file experiences.
